knowledge:
- key_parameters: file=Path to the HiC data file (.hic, .cool, .mcool, or .h5 format) ;; hicResolution=The resolution of the HiC map in base pairs (e.g., 5000) ;; interactionType=Defines "cis" or "trans" interactions to return or normalize in BalanceHiC ;; referencePoint=Set to "pf" (point feature/punctual) or "rf" (region feature/scaled) in ExtractSubmatrix ;; matriceDim=The dimension of the extracted submatrix (e.g., 41 or 101) ;; transFun=Transformation method (e.g., 'quantile') to rank local interactions in PrepareMtxList ;; areaFun=Coordinates or region where contact values are extracted in GetQuantif (e.g., "center" or custom function) ;; operationFun=Function applied to extracted values in GetQuantif (e.g., "mean" or custom function) ;; aggFun=Function used to aggregate matrices (e.g., "sum", "mean", "median") ;; diffFun=Function used to assess differences between two conditions in Aggregation (e.g., "substraction", "log2+1") ;; scaleCorrection=Boolean to enable noise reduction scaling against a background area in Aggregation ;; correctionArea=List of coordinates defining the background area for scale correction in Aggregation
- alternatives: TopDom (CRAN), HiTC (Bioconductor), or HiCDOC (Bioconductor) should be preferred for TAD calling, loop calling, or compartment analysis, which HicAggR does not perform.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have pre-called loops, TADs, or genomic features of interest (e.g., enhancers, promoters, CTCF sites) and want to analyze, quantify, and visualize their 3D interaction patterns (APA) under structural constraints.
- pitfalls: Selecting a subset of matrices using standard list indexing (e.g., matrices[1:20]) removes their metadata attributes (such as $interactions); use FilterInteractions instead to preserve attributes. Raw counts are imported by default, so matrix balancing (BalanceHiC) and observed/expected correction (OverExpectedHiC) must be manually executed. Setting statCompare = TRUE in Aggregation can be highly memory-intensive.

workflows.name: aggregation_peak_analysis
workflows.intent: Integrate 1D genomic features with 3D HiC data to perform Aggregation Peak Analysis (APA), quantify interaction signals, and visualize differential interaction patterns.
input: McoolOutput.pth (Heat Shock HiC file in .mcool format)
workflows.stages: 1. Import HiC data for both conditions using ImportHiC ;; 2. Perform matrix balancing using BalanceHiC ;; 3. Apply observed/expected distance normalization using OverExpectedHiC ;; 4. Index genomic features under TAD constraints using IndexFeatures ;; 5. Pair anchors and baits within constraints using SearchPairs ;; 6. Extract interaction submatrices using ExtractSubmatrix ;; 7. Filter submatrices based on metadata targets using FilterInteractions ;; 8. Correct matrix orientation using OrientateMatrix ;; 9. Prepare and transform matrix lists using PrepareMtxList ;; 10. Quantify interaction signals using GetQuantif ;; 11. Perform single or differential aggregation using Aggregation ;; 12. Plot APA heatmaps using ggAPA
workflows.code:
HiC_Ctrl.cmx_lst <- ImportHiC(
        file    = HicOutput.pth,
        hicResolution     = 5000,
        chrom_1 = c("2L", "2L", "2R"),
        chrom_2 = c("2L", "2R", "2R")
)
HiC_HS.cmx_lst <- ImportHiC(
        file    = McoolOutput.pth,
        hicResolution     = 5000,
        chrom_1 = c("2L", "2L", "2R"),
        chrom_2 = c("2L", "2R", "2R")
)
HiC_Ctrl.cmx_lst <- BalanceHiC(HiC_Ctrl.cmx_lst)
HiC_HS.cmx_lst <- BalanceHiC(HiC_HS.cmx_lst)
HiC_Ctrl.cmx_lst <- OverExpectedHiC(HiC_Ctrl.cmx_lst)
HiC_HS.cmx_lst <- OverExpectedHiC(HiC_HS.cmx_lst)
anchors_Index.gnr <- IndexFeatures(
    gRangeList        = list(Beaf=Beaf32_Peaks.gnr), 
    genomicConstraint        = TADs_Domains.gnr,
    chromSizes         = chromSizes,
    binSize           = binSize,
    metadataColName = "score",
    method            = "max"
    )
baits_Index.gnr <- IndexFeatures(
    gRangeList        = list(Tss=TSS_Peaks.gnr),
    genomicConstraint        = TADs_Domains.gnr,
    chromSizes         = chromSizes,
    binSize           = binSize,
    metadataColName = "score",
    method            = "max"
    )
non_Overlaps.ndx <- match(baits_Index.gnr$bin, 
    anchors_Index.gnr$bin, nomatch=0L)==0L
baits_Index.gnr <- baits_Index.gnr[non_Overlaps.ndx,]
interactions.gni <- SearchPairs(
        indexAnchor = anchors_Index.gnr,
        indexBait   = baits_Index.gnr
        )
interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst  <- ExtractSubmatrix(
    genomicFeature         = interactions.gni,
    hicLst        = HiC_Ctrl.cmx_lst,
    hicResolution            = NULL,
    referencePoint = "rf",
    matriceDim     = 101
    )
targets <- list(
    anchor.Beaf.name = c("Beaf32_62","Beaf32_204"),
    bait.Tss.name    = c("FBgn0015924","FBgn0264943"),
    name             = c("2L:25_2L:22"),
    distance         = function(columnElement){
        return(20000==columnElement || columnElement == 40000)
        }
    )
selectionFun = function(){
    Reduce(intersect, list(anchor.Beaf.name, bait.Tss.name ,distance) ) |>
    setdiff(name)
    }
filtred_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst <- FilterInteractions(
    matrices  = interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
    targets    = targets,
    selectionFun = selectionFun
    )
first100_targets = list(
    submatrix.name = names(interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst)[1:100]
    )
first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst <- FilterInteractions(
    matrices  = interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
    targets    = first100_targets,
    selectionFun = NULL
    )
oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst <- 
    OrientateMatrix(first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst)
oriented_quantiled_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst <- 
    PrepareMtxList(
        first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
        transFun = 'quantile',
        orientate = TRUE)
oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst <- 
    PrepareMtxList(
        first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
        orientate = TRUE)
center.num <- GetQuantif(
    matrices  = oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
    areaFun      = "center",
    operationFun = "mean"
    )
oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst = 
    PrepareMtxList(
        oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
        rm0 = FALSE)
agg_sum.mtx <- Aggregation(
    matrices = oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst, 
    aggFun      = "sum"
    )
interactions_RFmatrix.lst  <- ExtractSubmatrix(
    genomicFeature         = interactions.gni,
    hicLst        = HiC_HS.cmx_lst,
    referencePoint = "rf",
    matriceDim     = 101
    )
first100_interactions_RFmatrix.lst <- FilterInteractions(
    matrices  = interactions_RFmatrix.lst,
    targets    = first100_targets,
    selectionFun = NULL
    )
oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix.lst <- 
    OrientateMatrix(first100_interactions_RFmatrix.lst)
oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst = 
    PrepareMtxList(first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
        minDist   = NULL,
        maxDist   = NULL,
        rm0       = FALSE,
        orientate = TRUE
)
oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix.lst = 
    PrepareMtxList(first100_interactions_RFmatrix.lst,
        minDist   = NULL,
        maxDist   = NULL,
        rm0       = FALSE,
        orientate = TRUE
)
diffAggreg.mtx <- Aggregation(
    ctrlMatrices    = oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix_ctrl.lst,
    matrices        = oriented_first100_interactions_RFmatrix.lst,
    aggFun             = "mean",
    diffFun            = "substraction",
    scaleCorrection = TRUE,
    correctionArea  =  list(
        i = c(1:30),
        j = c(72:101)
        ),
    statCompare = TRUE)
ggAPA(
        aggregatedMtx   = diffAggreg.mtx,
        title = "APA"
)
